investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-20T12:26–12:27Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at the provisioning step. Because every check shares the same error message and no evidence was collected, the failure is localized to the swarm gateway dependency, not to individual check logic or eval infrastructure.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production API at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agents check calls POST /api/agents as its first step, which in turn proxies to the swarm ELB. The ELB returned a connection-level error before any agent could be provisioned, causing all three checks to fail with code bad_gateway and leaving the evidence object completely empty. This is an eval-observed infrastructure availability failure scoped to the swarm gateway; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

[Possible] The swarm service behind the ELB was restarting or had crashed, leaving the ELB with zero healthy instances and returning 502 to all incoming requests.
[Less likely] A transient network blip in us-east-2 caused a brief but complete loss of connectivity to the ELB during the ~40-second window spanning all three check runs (12:26:43–12:27:17Z).

investigations.title: published-observability-snapshot Eval Failure: Stale GitHub Actions Snapshot (snapshotAgeMinutes=715, max=300)
investigations.summary: The eval check `published-observability-snapshot` failed because the published status snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json is 715 minutes old, which exceeds the contract maximum of 300 minutes. All other public-website sibling checks passed, isolating the failure to the snapshot publication pipeline rather than the website itself.
investigations.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not run successfully in at least 715 minutes (~11.9 hours). The snapshot file is structurally valid and sourced from github-actions (evidence: failed-check.evidence), but its age violates the contract assertion `snapshotAgeMinutes max: 300` (evidence: expected-output.contract, source infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json line 482). This is an eval-detected staleness failure scoped to the snapshot publication workflow; no evidence of a user-facing website outage is present, as all three sibling page checks passed (evidence: sibling.public-observability-page, sibling.public-models-page, sibling.public-marketing-pages).
proof: failed-check.message: 'snapshotAgeMinutes expected <= 300 but got 715' — the sole violated assertion.

failed-check.evidence: snapshotAgeMinutes=715, maxAgeMinutes=300, source='github-actions', hasLiveSource=true, generatedAtPresent=true — the snapshot is structurally present and well-formed but stale.
expected-output.contract (infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json line 482): assertion { path: 'snapshotAgeMinutes', max: 300 } — the contract boundary that was breached.

sibling.public-observability-page, sibling.public-models-page, sibling.public-marketing-pages: all status=pass — confirms the public website is reachable and the failure is isolated to the snapshot data pipeline.
failed-check.evidence: overall='major_outage' — the stale snapshot itself reports a major_outage status, meaning the /observability page is displaying potentially outdated health data to visitors.
source-hint (infra/evals/status/features.json line 383): check config shows statusImpact='informational' and required=false — this eval failure does not itself constitute a required-check outage.

source-context (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs lines 2168-2173): the runner fetches the snapshot via publicJsonUrl(args.publishedSnapshotUrl) and derives snapshotAgeMinutes from the payload — confirming the age value is read directly from the live published file.
possibleCauses: The GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the observability snapshot has not triggered or completed successfully in over 11 hours — the most direct explanation supported by snapshotAgeMinutes=715 and source='github-actions' (failed-check.evidence).

The scheduled GitHub Actions workflow run was skipped, cancelled, or failed silently (e.g., due to a runner quota exhaustion, branch protection issue, or workflow configuration error), leaving the previously published snapshot in place.
The workflow ran but the publish step (e.g., GitHub Pages deployment) failed after snapshot generation, so the file at the snapshotUrl was not updated even though a run occurred.
